info.title: Massive Stock Market Data API
info.description: Curated read-only Massive stock market REST API surface for quotes, aggregates, snapshots, and ticker reference data. Massive was formerly Polygon.io; endpoint access, recency, and history vary by subscription plan.

get.description: Retrieve the latest available trade for a case-sensitive stock ticker. The result includes price, size, exchange, conditions, and nanosecond timestamps when supplied by the feed. Availability and recency depend on the account's stock-data plan.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Officially documented endpoint; availability depends on the account's market-data plan.

get.description: Retrieve the previous trading day's OHLC, volume, VWAP, and transaction count for a stock ticker. Results are split-adjusted by default.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

get.description: Retrieve historical OHLC and volume bars over a custom date range in Eastern Time. Bars are built from qualifying trades; an interval with no eligible trades is omitted rather than returned as an empty bar.

get.description: Retrieve paginated snapshots across stocks, options, forex, crypto, and indices. A snapshot can include current session metrics plus the latest trade, quote, and minute bar according to plan entitlements.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order results using the selected sort field.

schema.description: Order results using the selected sort field.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Official unified snapshot endpoint; returned fields and recency vary by asset-class subscription.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of ticker symbols across supported asset classes. Filter by symbol, asset type, market, exchange, identifiers, date, search text, or active status.

parameters.description: Ticker type code from the Ticker Types endpoint.

schema.description: Ticker type code from the Ticker Types endpoint.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Primary exchange Market Identifier Code (MIC), for example `XNAS`.

schema.description: Primary exchange Market Identifier Code (MIC), for example `XNAS`.
